verdict.rationale: Conductor runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in isolated workspaces. Its docs say the agent can test repositories and run builds, and failing-check logs and PR comments surface in cloud workspaces, but none of the four named tasks is specifically documented. Missing for 10: documented agent test-writing, lint-error fixing, merge-conflict resolution, dependency updates, and any hands-on corroboration of these tasks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent write tests, fix lint errors, resolve merge conflicts, and update dependencies for me

citations.quote: Conductor lets you run Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode in parallel.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
PR comments and failing-check logs now load while a cloud workspace is asleep.
